sap_media_projects.title: SAP BTP Hackathon Prague 2024 – Event Coverage & Content
sap_media_projects.tech: Adobe After Effects, Adobe Premiere Pro, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Lightroom, Figma
sap_media_projects.description: Served as event chronicler for the 4-day SAP BTP Hackathon 2024 in Prague with teams from Asahi, BKV, CCC, Euro Cash, Slovenske Elektrarne, SumUp, TGW, and Zabka Polska. Captured photos and videos, edited on-the-fly under tight deadlines, created LinkedIn social cards for all SAP and client team members, and conducted 8 pre-planned interviews with key client representatives and SAP personnel.

sap_media_projects.tech: Unreal Engine, Stream Decks, Panasonic Controllers, SAP VMS, Blackmagic Decoders
sap_media_projects.description: Manage end-to-end studio operations at SAP's Immersive Experience (IX) Studio in Walldorf. Design 3D environments for a 12-foot LED screen, operate 5-camera systems with stream decks and Panasonic controllers, manage audio engineering for up to 12 microphones, and deliver 6-8 hybrid events weekly including IBM SAP Power Customer Council and SAP Expert Series productions.
sap_media_projects.impact: 6-8 professional hybrid events weekly with 100+ attendees, 12-foot LED immersive productions

creative_media_projects.title: Tiltification – Spirit Level Smartphone App (Published)
creative_media_projects.description: Designed UX/UI for Tiltification, a spirit level app published on both Play Store and App Store. The app uses acoustic signal feedback for precise dual-axis object alignment — more accurate than traditional bubble levels. Designed multiple screen states, dark/light modes, and intuitive controls for hands-free usage.
creative_media_projects.impact: Published app on Play Store and App Store with acoustic-based precision leveling

Performed competitive analysis, developed personas, built mind maps and information architecture, created task flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity prototypes with interactive UI screens.
creative_media_projects.impact: Complete design process documentation from research to interactive prototype for healthcare app
